title: Resident engine and title

exclude: X-Ray trainer during startup. An instruction breakpoint at $CDB0 reached it before the five N replies led to the $084C hand-over.
Runtime workspace. VICE recorded no instruction fetches here in the sampled title and gameplay. The title temporarily holds the authored C800-CBFF tables at 0400-07FF before clearing that workspace.
HUD display cells and sprite pointers. $84FD regenerates the screen from $E158 and $E200 and $8329 installs the sprite pointers. The authored templates are tracked at their original addresses.

X-Ray bootstrap bytes observed intact in the crack intro before engine depacking. The $0816/$0819 loader copy wrote the identical 56-byte sequence from $96AA-$96E1. The Censor release has different RAM here and the loader call at $FFC0 enters KERNAL ROM.
include: VIC graphics in RAM beneath I/O. The title selects $D000 and uses sprites at $D300-$D4FF. The forest status panel selects $D800.

io: Copy into RAM under the chips with the processor port set to $32.

Disk configuration and display writes with I/O visible.
The engine writes $35 at $800D and keeps I/O in view for gameplay and title.
